{
 "path": "programs/task-cc637199.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    marker = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (bg, 0)), None)
    if marker is None:
        return out
    left = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] == 0]
    right = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][-1] == 0]
    # Seed rows paint toward the nearest zero border, with the seed cell
    # converted to the stop marker 4.
    for r in range(h):
        for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if v == marker:
                out[r][c] = 4
                edge = 0 if r in left else (w-1 if r in right else None)
                if edge is not None:
                    step = 1 if edge > c else -1
                    j = c + step
                    while j != edge:
                        out[r][j] = marker
                        j += step
    # Extend the seed color across rows touched by the boundary bar when the
    # opposite side has a matching bar segment.
    for r in right:
        for c in range(w-1): out[r][c] = marker
    return out
"
}
